title: Take a seat
body:
Play with friends

Your seat is remembered in this browser. No account form is needed.

Already playing here? Resume your table from the saved-table list.
action: Enter a name, select 2–4 seats and create; follow an invitation to join; resume an existing seat. Anonymous sign-in happens before mutation.
signifier: Selected player count has a gold outline and text. Create is disabled while signing in; inline validation names the field.
transition: Create → 03; invitation → 02; resume → latest legal state. Sign-in failure → 23.

title: Join Ariadne’s table
body:
A seat is waiting

Host: Ariadne · 1 of 2 seats occupied

Joining keeps your seat in this browser. You can reload and return.
action: Review host and capacity, enter your name, then Join table once. An existing member resumes instead of taking a second seat.
signifier: Capacity is explicit; joining shows one pending state and disables resubmission.
transition: Acknowledged join → 03. Full, missing or started table → 23. The last-seat race has one winner.

title: Your table
body:
Seats · 2 of 2

Ariadne · host · hereTheseus · here

Turn order is drawn when the host starts. Leaders are chosen in reverse turn order.

Theseus joined the table.

What you will start with

6 Obols + 3 Hamlets + your god’s Temple. The Temple shown is an example until you choose a leader.
action: Copy the invitation. Host starts once every seat is occupied; guests see “Waiting for Ariadne to start.”
signifier: Each occupied seat names its player and connection state. Start has a visible reason when disabled.
transition: Join animates seat entrance once. Start commits first player and draft order → 04; no cards are dealt yet.

title: Choose your bloodline
body:
Turn order: Ariadne → Theseus. Theseus chooses first; Ariadne chooses last.

Theseus is choosingYour choice is next
action: Active drafter inspects an unused leader and confirms Choose [name]. Other players browse but cannot claim.
signifier: Current drafter is named; chosen leaders show owner and are unavailable. Landscape leaders retain their larger form factor.
transition: Claim travels to its seat; matching event and Temple preview appear. Advance backward in turn order. Last claim → 05.

title: Your empire begins
body:
Ariadne · Athena

You take the first turn. Thaleia’s first matching Action grants +1 Action.

Your starting deck

6 Obols · 3 Hamlets · 1 Temple of Athena. Shuffle all ten and draw five.

Shared gods: Athena and Poseidon. All twelve Action piles are available. Territories: 6 each · Actions: 8 each.
action: See my hand dismisses the setup explanation locally; no readiness vote or extra game rule is introduced.
signifier: Your actual leader, god and Temple are shown together. The first player and supply scale are explicit.
transition: Authoritative setup commits once after the last draft. Deal five backs into each seat; only the owner sees faces → 06.

title: Your turn · Actions
body:
1actions

1buys

Your hand · 5 cards

Cards 1–3 of 5 · 2 more Obols

Your bloodline

Bloodline ready · first Athena Action → +1 Action. Leaders grant no Devotion.

Deck 5 · discard 0 · in play 0. Select a card to inspect before playing. Worship is available between effects.
action: Select a hand card; Play spends an Action and resolves all effects plus its leader trigger. Inspect is always separate from committing. Advance to Treasures voluntarily.
signifier: Legal cards have a gold outline and “Ready to play”; selected cards have a checkmark. Territories explain that they score at game end.
transition: Hand → play motion and counter changes, then leader pulse. Choices → 12/13/14. Phase advance → 07. Worship → 10.

body:

Choose Treasures to play

Play one at a time to keep a Treasure in hand for a later effect. You cannot return to Actions.

In play: Temple of Athena · Athena Devotion 1 · Bloodline used
action: Play individual Treasures or use explicit Play all Treasures. Continue to Buys; confirmation is required only if playable Treasures would be left behind.
signifier: Coins update as each committed Treasure enters play. Hand cards remain targetable for later trash effects if left unplayed.
transition: Each played card moves to the play area; batch playback remains ordered. Between individual plays Worship remains available → 10. Advance → 08.

action: Switch Basics/Actions, filter only the view, inspect a pile, and confirm Buy in its detail panel. Buy a cost-0 card still spends one Buy.
signifier: Each pile has a separate remaining count, independent of the face’s physical N/M. Affordable piles gain a Buy affordance; others state “Need 3 more Coins”, “No Buys” or “Empty”.
transition: Pile selection → 09. Purchase moves one face to discard; count and counters settle atomically. Additional buys stay here. End turn → 17.

title: Polis
body:
Supply · 6 left

Territory · Hestia

3

Costs 5 Coins and 1 Buy. Gain this card to your discard pile. It scores 3 VP at game end.

After buying: 0 Coins · 0 Buys. This is a purchase, not Worship.
action: Read the full rules and inspect the unchanged card; confirm one context-specific action or close without a mutation. In-hand details offer Play only when legal.
signifier: Destination, payment and resulting counters appear beside the committing button. Copy serial stays separate from supply stock.
transition: Desktop modal, mobile full-height sheet; focus is trapped and restored on Close/Escape. Buy → 08, keeping the selected pile in view.

title: Worship
body:
0actions
5coins
1buys
2worship

Athena · Favored

Shared with everyone · Athena Devotion 2 · Temple of Athena + Oracle’s Acolyte in play. Favored replaces Standard

Pay 1 Worship + 3 Coins; no Buy.

Poseidon · Standard

Poseidon Devotion 0 · You may Worship another bloodline’s god.

Pay 1 Worship + 3 Coins. No Buy is spent. Available between fully resolved effects, before cleanup.
action: Inspect any god selected at setup. Review automatically selected Standard/Favored effect and confirm Worship; no toggle can override Devotion.
signifier: Matching in-play Actions are named as the Devotion source. Favored is labeled, not color alone; both printed effects remain visible.
transition: Payment commits before resolution. Event stays in the shared area and never depletes. Resolve choices → 12/14; return to the original phase. Repeated Worship is legal if affordable.

title: Resolving Temple of Athena
body:
1actions
0coins
1buys
2worship

Played by Ariadne

+1+1

Next · Thaleia’s bloodline

First Athena Action this turn → +1 Action. Resolves after the Temple.
action: Wait for automatic instructions; make a choice only when the effect requests it. Do not allow another command to interrupt a card or leader.
signifier: Source card, instruction and upcoming leader are visible. Disabled actions name the reason; progress is finite, not an indefinite spinner.
transition: Resolve printed instructions in order, then leader. This is a transient state; assert it using a controlled animation clock, not a timing race. Settle → prior phase.

title: Seed Keeper · choose cards
body:
21 selected · up to 2

From your hand

Trashed cards leave your deck and score for nobody. Cards already in play cannot be selected.
action: Toggle zero to the permitted maximum from your hand; confirm exact selected count. Trash none is always available for optional trash, including Doreios.
signifier: Selected cards have a checkmark and a running count. The red-tinted destination uses the approved broken-card icon and text.
transition: Confirmed cards reveal publicly and move to shared trash. Continue the effect; for Forge/Trial zero means no gain. Doreios consumes the trigger even when skipped.

title: Harvest Feast · discard 1
body:
11 selected · required

Choose from your hand after drawing

Draw two first. You may discard a card you just drew. Discarded cards stay yours.
action: Choose the required number from the post-draw hand. No skip while an eligible card exists; do as much as possible if the hand is smaller.
signifier: Required count and destination distinguish this from optional trash and topdeck. Newly drawn cards are labeled without excluding them.
transition: Hand → own discard, then the leader trigger and prior phase. An empty hand auto-completes with a named “No cards to discard” message.

title: Counsel of Olympus · gain
body:
5Action · Favored

Choose one Action costing up to 5. Place it on top of your deck; it is not drawn or played.

Eligible supply · page 1 of 4
action: Select one eligible nonempty supply pile, inspect if needed, and confirm Gain. No Coins or Buys are charged by the choice itself. Optional Demeter gain offers Gain nothing.
signifier: One gain icon contains the cost limit; topdeck appears only when required. Source effect, type restriction and destination are explicit; no ≤ or redundant Coin icon.
transition: Reveal the gained face publicly, decrement stock and move to discard or topdeck. No eligible pile auto-skips gain, explains why, and still resolves later instructions.

title: Victorious Procession
body:
Revealed from your deck

+2

A Territory was revealed

Hamlet moves to your discard pile. Gain 2 more Coins. The initial +2 Coins and +1 Buy have already resolved.

Everyone sees the revealed face. It is held outside the deck and discard until this instruction finishes.
action: No choice is invented for a conditional reveal. Resolve automatically; open the activity record afterward to inspect what happened.
signifier: Show the revealed face and the exact branch/destination. A non-Territory shows Topdeck instead, without the bonus Coins.
transition: Deck back → public face → discard or deck. If deck empty, shuffle discard first; if both empty, report no reveal but keep initial rewards.

title: Choose the next card drawn
body:
First drawn → last drawn

Cards going onto your deck

Use Move earlier / later or the keyboard. Dragging is optional.
action: When a future effect puts multiple cards on top together, set first-to-last draw order and confirm. This generic rules state is not reachable with the current card set.
signifier: Numbered order and a “Draw first” label avoid ambiguous stack direction; move buttons are equivalent to drag.
transition: Commit one order and return to the effect. Keep this screen dormant in v0.1; do not invent a card effect to expose it.

title: Finish your turn?
body:
0actions
2coins
1buys
1worship

Before cleanup

You still have 2 Coins, 1 Buy and 1 Worship. You can buy a Hamlet or an Obol; you cannot afford Worship.

Ending discards your hand and played cards, clears resources, and draws five. You cannot Worship once cleanup begins.
action: Confirm cleanup when useful resources or legal actions remain; otherwise the explicit End turn command can proceed directly. Decline returns unchanged.
signifier: Name actual remaining legal options, not just nonzero counters. No automatic end when Buys run out: Worship may still be possible.
transition: Hand/play → discard, counters → zero, shuffle only as needed, draw five; check end condition after cleanup → 18 or 21.

action: Follow the active player’s public moves; inspect your own hand and public piles while waiting. Do not queue out-of-turn game commands.
signifier: Active player’s name stays next to resource counters. A persistent actor/card/destination sentence remains after animation.
transition: Committed public actions animate once in event order. Private draws use backs. If another tab is open, show an activity badge without forcing navigation.

title: Public piles
body:
Theseus’s discard · 3 cards

All discarded cards are public. Inspect without changing order or contents.

7Theseus’s deck · count only

No face, serial number or ordered list from another player’s deck or hand is available.
action: Switch public owner/zone, page through all cards and inspect faces. Deck inspection returns only the count; your own hand remains privately accessible.
signifier: Zone heading includes owner and count; shared trash has a distinct broken-card icon. No reorder handles on read-only piles.
transition: Open as desktop side panel or mobile full-height sheet. Close restores prior phase/tab/scroll/focus; state continues updating behind it.

action: Read public events in order, inspect referenced cards and load earlier history. No rewind, undo or replay-as-command action.
signifier: Names, source → destination and resource deltas explain each event. Turn grouping replaces unstable wall-clock timestamps.
transition: Append new activity with a small entrance; preserve the reader’s position and offer “New actions”. Reconnect catches up without replaying the entire animation queue.

title: Ariadne’s victory
body:
The Acropolis pile emptied. The current turn finished; there is no final round.

Ariadne · 24 VP

2412 turns

3 Hamlets × 1 + 3 Poleis × 3 + 2 Acropoleis × 6 = 24

Theseus · 21 VP

2111 turns

3 Hamlets × 1 + 2 Poleis × 3 + 2 Acropoleis × 6 = 21
action: Review final territory totals across all owned zones and turns taken. Create another table returns to setup with the name remembered; it never resets this game.
signifier: State the end reason, exact VP arithmetic and tie resolution. For equal points use fewer turns, then “Shared victory”.
transition: After cleanup/check, final counters settle and results appear with a modest laurel fade. The completed table stays read-only and reloadable.

title: Reconnecting to your table
body:
Your seat is saved in this browser

You are offline. The table below is the last confirmed state. Game actions are unavailable until we reconnect.

Last confirmed · Ariadne’s Actions

1actions
0coins
1buys
1worship

If a move was already sent, we will check whether it succeeded before you can try again.
action: Retry connection; continue reading confirmed public information. Never optimistically queue purchases or privately reshuffle offline.
signifier: Text + connection indicator distinguishes connecting, sending, synced, offline and failed; “Sending…” is not success.
transition: On recovery restore canonical state/private view and reconcile command ID. No duplicate effect, no animation backlog. Restore pending choice or show whose turn it now is.

title: This table is full
body:
All seats have been taken

Another player joined the final seat first. You have not joined this game.

If this was your seat, return using the original browser. An anonymous seat cannot be recovered after its browser storage is cleared.
action: Recover using the original browser or return to setup. Missing/invalid invitation, already-started nonmember, sign-in failure and unsupported history use this same shell with specific copy and safe actions.
signifier: Plain-language reason; no raw Firebase error, game document ID, stack trace or disabled spinner trap.
transition: Retry only recoverable failures. Lost identity never silently replaces another seat. Existing members may resume a full or started game.

title: Table options
body:
Display and access

Ariadne · host. Your seat lives in this browser; an invitation does not transfer it.

Open the display link on the shared screen. It grants public viewing only; it cannot join a seat or play cards.

Motion and help

Reduced motion retains the same activity messages and final state.
action: Copy lobby invite, issue/revoke a public-display capability as host, or set reduced motion locally. No restart, kick, surrender, transfer-seat or speed setting is implied for v0.1.
signifier: Player invite and public display link are explicitly different controls. Copy provides textual success/failure; a selectable URL is the fallback.
transition: Options overlay returns to prior view. Leaving the page keeps the seat; untrusted display links expire/revoke and return to 23. Capability support is future backend work.

title: How to play
body:
Your turn

Start with 1 Action, 1 Buy, 1 Worship and 0 Coins. Play Actions, then Treasures, then buy cards. You may Worship between resolved effects in any phase before cleanup.

Your Temple adds 1 Worship and 1 Action. Finish its effect and your leader trigger before Worship. Cleanup discards hand and play, clears resources and draws five.
action: Open contextual rules, use the shared sticky section navigation, read actual card examples and return without losing the pending game choice.
signifier: Concise document prose and familiar card imagery; current section has an underline and aria-current. A game badge indicates ongoing activity.
transition: Rules scroll as a document; they do not pause the game. Return restores the prior view, unless acknowledged state has advanced. Existing /rules remains the canonical summary.

title: Card reference
body:
Actions · Athena

Inspect any card to read its full text. The catalog shows inventory copy numbers, not your game’s remaining piles.
action: Search/filter all thirty definitions, inspect any physical copy/front/back and print using the established gallery. No catalog button purchases a card.
signifier: Same StickyNav as the rules; clear “Card reference” scope. Deck/event/leader backs remain distinct.
transition: Reference opens without replacing the seat. The full existing gallery remains a scrolling document; return restores the game context.
